abstract: OBJECTIVE: To review our experience with thoracotomy in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN). STUDY DESIGN: Nineteen thoracotomy patients from our database were identified. Thoracotomy was performed for therapeutic reasons in 11 patients and to clarify the diagnosis in eight. RESULTS: Among the 11 patients with chemotherapy-resistant pulmonary tumors, 10 of 11 (90.9%) achieved remission with thoracotomy. Thoracotomy was more likely to be done to clarify diagnosis before 1980 (83%) than after 1980 (23%) (p = 0.04), when it became more likely to be done for therapeutic indications. Ten patients had solitary lung lesions and 9 had multiple lesions. Four patients died (21%), with an average survival after thoracotomy of 149 days; patients had bilateral or multiple lung lesions, median preoperative hCG was 58,000 mIU/mL and all were stage IV. Survivors had lower stage disease, were more likely to have solitary lesions and had lower preoperative hCG levels. CONCLUSION: There have been several temporal changes in the indications for thoracotomy for GTN. In general, the optimal patient to achieve remission with thoracotomy will have stage III disease, a preoperative hCG of < 1,500 mIU/mL, and a solitary lung nodule resistant to chemotherapy. Likelihood of remission after thoracotomy is high in properly selected patients.
abstract_ja:
目的：妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)における開胸術の経験を検討すること。
研究デザイン：当データベースから開胸術を受けた19例を抽出した。開胸術は治療目的が11例、診断の確定目的が8例で施行された。
結果：化学療法抵抗性の肺腫瘍を有する11例のうち、10例(90.9%)が開胸術により寛解を得た。開胸術が診断確定目的で行われる割合は、1980年以前は83%、1980年以降は23%であり(p=0.04)、以降は治療目的で行われる傾向が強まった。10例は単発の肺病変、9例は多発病変を有していた。4例(21%)が死亡し、開胸術後の平均生存期間は149日であった。死亡例は両側または多発肺病変を有し、術前hCG中央値は58,000 mIU/mLで、全例が病期IVであった。生存者は病期が低く、単発病変が多く、術前hCG値が低かった。
結論：GTNにおける開胸術の適応は時代とともに変化してきた。一般に、寛解が得られやすい最適な症例は、病期III期、術前hCG 1,500 mIU/mL未満、化学療法抵抗性の単発肺結節を有する患者である。適切に選択された患者では、開胸術後の寛解の可能性は高い。
